description: This Java class 'ProductDisplayWorker' provides utility methods for retrieving related products, quick reorder suggestions, and product ordering logic within the OFBiz e-commerce framework, specifically for shopping cart and product display functionalities.

classes.name: ProductDisplayWorker
classes.description: Utility class for product display and related product retrieval in shopping cart context.

methods.name: getRandomCartProductAssoc
methods.description: Retrieves a random list of associated products (e.g., cross-sell, complement) related to items in the shopping cart, with optional category view filtering.

methods.name: getQuickReorderProducts
methods.description: Generates a list of products for quick reorder based on user's past orders, considering product quantities and occurrences, with filtering based on cart contents and category restrictions.

methods.name: productOrderByMap
methods.description: Sorts a list of products based on a provided mapping of product IDs to comparison values, either ascending or descending.
